notes.title: Seedlings 1 year anniversary update. Added 'Chapters'
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thanks again for the support for Seedlings this last year. It's crazy to think that a year has passed already.

The most requested feature is finally here, A chapter select system you can access from the menu once you have completed the story. Now you can go back and get the collectables you missed on the first playthrough without having to go though the entire game again.

There's more that I will like to add in the future. I'm thinking of a challenge level that isn't part of the main game but something much more difficult using the rope mechanics. More on that later. I'm also working on a completely new game but haven't got anything ready to share for that yet.

Thanks again to everyone who has bought and played Seedlings this last year. I wanted to do something simple for my first game, and that ended up taking 5 years. Going back, I have learned so much from the whole experience. 

I'm glad that the people that have played it enjoyed it.

notes.title: Seedlings - added levels, new languages and other visual fixes.
notes.content:
Seedlings update for 5th May 2024.


Rearranged some levels with new biome artwork so the level difficulty rises consistently.
Added a new level to showcase the bouncing on box mechanic. A lot were getting stuck at one level.
Added subtitles for 4 more languages - Swedish, Polish, Russian and Italian.
 Other visual fixes on some levels.

notes.title: Update notes for 26 September
notes.content:
Fixed a place where you could get stuck after launching seed at a dragonfly
A few minor visual tweaks

notes.title: Seedlings is out in a week!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DLe1lhA_Bj4;full][/previewyoutube]

Seedlings is coming out on September 22

Hi everyone. Thanks for the interest in Seedlings up until now. I'm excited and anxious for what happens next week. Over the years I have had so many positive comments so I really hope that Seedlings can meet peoples expectations. 

It's crazy to think that what started as an idea for a game jam has come to this. 

Please Wishlist Seedlings if you haven't already. I hope you all enjoy the full game once it's out!

Cheers,

Peter.
